reviewer.tool: agent image read tool on the PNG files listed below

observations: The six-probe row resolves the authored base colours, metallic 0/1/0.5, roughness 0.1/0.8/0.4/0.3/0.05/0.6, clearcoat 0.75, transmission 0.9, coverage alpha 0.5, IOR/F0 and the masked-cutout bucket in both the channel images and the numeric HDR readback (83/83 checks).
The UV1 channel is advertised unsupported and renders as the deliberate magenta marker on every probe; no neutral fallback is presented as authored data.
The emission channel isolates the emissive probe; the coat channel isolates the clearcoat probe; the metallic and roughness channels show only their authored constants, not lighting.

Car windshield/side-window pixels are dominated by environment specular (0.698 mean linear vs 0.057 environment diffuse), consistent with the recorded bright/speckled glass defect. Paint is also environment-specular dominated (0.188).
Camera lens and black body are environment-specular dominated at the sampled lens region (0.081) with low direct terms; the lens remains dark with visible reflection depth.
Suit torso is environment-diffuse dominated (0.093) ahead of direct diffuse (0.075), so changing only the direct key would not isolate its appearance.
These dominance readings are numeric observations from isolated channels. They do not claim a proven root cause where no isolated A/B comparison was run.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Bright windshield/side glass with dotted white speckles; environment specular dominates. Authored coverage alpha and transmission remain separate in the diagnostic record but are not yet composited as a physical transmission path.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Roof/window interpenetration still reads as a flat plate without layered glass depth. T21 records the bucket and depth-write state per material; ordering remains T26.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: The lens is dark with a visible environment reflection. T21 does not establish the transmitted scene sampling or tint it should show; that is T26/T27 work.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Only scalar clearcoat/sheen/specular/transmission values reach the wire; texture-driven versions are still warning-only. The unbound slot identities are recorded, not presented as authored maps.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: AO is still read from the metallic-roughness map's red channel when bound; independent occlusion texture identity is T22 work.

positives: Debug inspection channels expose raw linear values and the display clamp is the only clamp; numeric HDR readback preserves values above display range.
Material/texture identity is verified from a source-authored probe fixture, with source metadata parsed only in test tooling.
Release still rejects every test-control message, including the new T21 fields (all responses 0).
The per-material record links primitive/material/source ids, validated wire values, bound texture identity/color space/sampler/UV and the effective bucket, depth-write and cull state.
